ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI — No Auto Camera Jump [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description:
Keep your camera where you left it when a local ISEKAI hunt spawns its target.
Camera behaviour
• Stops the forced camera jump for ordinary local ISEKAI hunts and hunt packs from ISEKAI CREATURES. • Keeps letters, messages and clickable target links, so you can jump to the target when you choose. • Leaves regular RimWorld camera jumps, world bosses, hero visits and Guild duels unchanged.
Controls and settings RimWorld’s Mod Settings has separate switches for ordinary hunts and creature hunt packs. Both are enabled by default. Changes apply immediately and are saved in RimWorld’s configuration.
Requirements and installation Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony and ISEKAI RPG LEVELING. Load after these dependencies and any Guild/Creatures add-ons. English and Russian interface text is included. A compiled DLL is included; no build is needed to play.
ISEKAI CREATURES is optional; its switch applies only when that add-on is installed.
This update changes the package ID from chupakobra6.isekai.noautohuntcamerajump to starsky.rimworld.isekai.noautohuntcamerajump. If the mod is no longer active after updating, re-enable it in your mod list.
Can be added to an existing save; back up before removal. Original ISEKAI files are neither included nor modified.
Found a bug? Include reproduction steps, mod versions and your log.
